We use the evaluation metrics in the original ALCE benchmark. Correctness Recall measures the percentage of gold answers captured by the response. Citation Recall measures the percentage of sentences in the response that are entailed by their cited passages. Citation Precision measures the percentage of citations that can help support the output sentences. We also report MAUVE for fluency.
